column3: Travelled keenly close to the pace - second at halfway - moved through to the front before 2f out - shaken up inside the final furlong and a half - won comfortably
Settled in the pack early - 4th at halfway - urged forward approaching 2f out - moved into 2nd inside final furlong - stayed on under pressure but unable to overhaul winner
Settled in the pack early - still in touch in 5th at halfway - suffered a heavy check inside the final 3f - driven up into 3rd approaching the last furlong before fading to finish third
Travelled keenly early - hit the front soon after the start - driven to stay ahead but overtaken 2f out - lost touch inside the final furlong to finish 4th
Settled at back of field - urged forward from 3f out - stayed on without threatening the front runners - finished 5th
Held up towards the back - 6th at halfway - urged into effort 3f out - faded fast from 2f out and never a threat
Sets pace early - overtaken soon after - third by halfway - gives way rapidly two out and finishes well adrift
Pulled hard in third - moved up smoothly 4f out - challenged at the front over 2f out and driven - edged ahead over 1f out - ground on resolutely through a prolonged battle to win

Positioned wide in the early stages - hit the front - pressed for effort with 3f to go as rivals closed - urged along 2f out - lost the advantage by a short margin inside the final furlong - fought back gamely all the way to the line - denied by the smallest of margins
Fidgety before the off - settled just behind the pace - lost touch with the front three furlongs out and faded to finish third
Held up towards the back - quick progress to close on the pacesetter early - edged in front turning for home - pushed clear inside the final furlong - margin shortened late but held on to score

Slow to begin and hampered exiting stalls - dropped a touch off the pace early - joined main group by 2f - made headway approaching midpoint - fifth and knuckling down inside final furlong - finished second going forward but couldn't get up
Held up towards the back of the pack - still down in 10th with a couple of furlongs left - found room and picked up inside the final furlong - kept finding late to snatch 3rd on the line
Settled with the pack early - 5th turning for home - pushed along inside final furlong and stayed on but never landed a threat
Raced handy - 4th turning into straight - moved up to 3rd with 1 1/2f left then 2nd inside final furlong - dropped back and unable to threaten late finishing 5th

Sat close to the front early - third turning into the straight - slipped back and asked for effort with 1 1/2f left - faded before the furlong pole and finished 6th holding a steady effort to the line
Held up towards the back - shaped up inside the final two furlongs - stayed on through the closing stages to finish seventh
Settled in the pack early - still 8th with 3f left and unable to build a threat approaching the final furlong - stayed on at one tempo to the line finishing 8th

Settled midfield early - still close enough after three furlongs - pushed along in 6th turning for home - dropped back and driven two out - unable to close final furlong - held on same effort through the finish to be beaten well

Settled just off the pace early - midfield after three furlongs - 9th approaching the final 3f - crept forward on the inside with 2f left - couldn't threaten leaders in the last furlong and held on for 10th
Settled towards the back of the pack - still 11th with 2 1/2f left and unable to threaten inside the final furlong - held to one gear at the finish
Went straight to front early - overtaken turning in and dropped away over a furlong out - faded through the closing stages to finish well beaten
Settled with the pack early - 7th turning for home - improved into contention approaching 3f out - dropped away final furlong to finish well held
Held up towards the back - unable to make headway with a furlong and a half left - faded to finish well beaten in 14th
Held up at the back - failed to make progress through the race - one-paced finish and beaten well into 15th
Held up at the back - unable to make headway approaching 2f out - dropped away inside final furlong to finish well beaten
Held up towards the back - slipped further behind approaching the final 3f - faded from contention and well held at the line
Settled in behind early - angled left approaching 2f out - pushed along and found room inside final furlong - edged left and kept responding to the line - got up close home to prevail
Handy early - pushed clear a furlong out - edged left inside final furlong - caught close home to finish second by a short head
Settled just behind the pace - moved up easily 3f from home - pressed for effort inside final furlong and briefly disputed the lead - weakened close home to finish third
Set the pace early - pushed along with 2f to go - lost command inside the final furlong - faded close home to finish fourth
Sat close to the pace early - driven and dropped back with 2f left - faded quickly to finish fifth
Racing mid-pack early - urged forward with 3f left - soon slipped to the rear and lost touch with the field - trailed home in 6th
Settled at the back early - some way off the pace at halfway - stayed on strongly outside approaching 2 out to hit the front - driven out before the last - stuck on well to win
Held up towards the back - urged forward and moved right before 2 out - driven approaching the last - stayed on up the run-in but couldn't get to the winner

Held up towards the back - stumbled at the 4th - 8th at halfway - driven into contention before 2 out - asked for effort before the last - clipped the last and stayed on without further improvement to finish 3rd

Settled midpack out wide early - up to 4th by halfway - driven on approaching two out and hit that fence - urged again before the last - stayed on same gear to the line - finished 4th beaten just under seven lengths
Set the pace early - shared front spot from the 3rd - blundered and lost top spot 4 out - regained control after 3 out - shaken up but overtaken before 2 out and unable to respond up the straight
Settled in the pack early - 5th at halfway - dropped away under pressure before two out and never threatened the front - finished 6th
Settled handy in the pack pulling hard - up in third at halfway - shared the front spot approaching two out - dropped away before the final flight and came home well beaten in 7th
Settled in the pack - 7th at halfway - urged forward after three out - improved position before two out under pressure - faded fast before the last and finished well beaten
Handy early - shared front-running from the 3rd - lost place and faded fast after 3 out then eased down before the last
Settled towards the back of the pack - 6th at the halfway stage - squeezed for space and faded fast before two out then pulled up before the last
Wide in the opening stages before slotting into midfield after 3f - travelling easily made ground on the outer 3f out - asserted over 1f out and forged ahead - ran on to score convincingly
Held up towards the back - made progress into the straight - moved left and driven on approaching the furlong marker - up to third with a strong finish - kept on but unable to trouble the winner
Wide early - settled with the pack after three furlongs - held a midfield spot - made progress three out - asked for effort two out and reached the top group - stayed on at one speed to finish third
Moved left after the break - settled towards the back - driven up with over 2f left - kept responding inside the final furlong - moved into fourth late but held for 4th
Held up towards the back - made progress from 2f out - stayed on inside the final furlong - unable to land a blow to finish 5th
Held up towards the back - asked for effort with 3f remaining - stayed on without threatening finished 6th
Settled in the pack - roused with more than 2f left and made some ground - drifted left approaching the final furlong then found nothing more - finished seventh
Started out wide - crossed over to the front after three furlongs - driven approaching the final 2f - overtaken with over a furlong left and faded fast
Held up towards the back - roused with three furlongs left - unable to quicken - beaten 16¾ lengths in 9th
Up with the pace - nudged for effort 2f out - faded before the final furlong
Settled in the pack early - pushed along and faded from over 2f out - finished well held in 11th
Sat close to the front group - urged forward with 3f left - dropped away 2f out to finish well beaten
Held up in the middle of the pack - nudged for effort 3f out - making no inroads when hampered just past the 1f marker - beaten 25.5 lengths into 13th
Handy early - urged into effort with over 2f left - dropped away with more than a furlong to run - eventually finished 14th
Sat close to the front group early - urged forward with more than two furlongs left - faded softly through the closing stages to finish 15th

Settled just behind pace early - into 3rd before halfway - improved into 2nd turning for home - edged in front over 3f out then lost that spot 2f out - regained advantage a furlong out - stayed on strongly to prevail
Settled early with the pack - pushed into 2nd before halfway - 3rd turning into the straight - edged in front just over 2f out - overtaken with a furlong left - stayed on for the runner-up spot
Settled midfield - still 7th at halfway - moved into 4th approaching final 2f - up to 3rd with a furlong left - stayed on well but couldn't get to the front two
Settled handy early - 4th at halfway - dropped to 5th approaching final 2f - unable to reach front pair but rallied late to finish 4th
Held up towards the back - still 6th at halfway - pushed along a furlong and a half out - made no headway approaching final furlong - stayed on late to take 5th
Went straight to front early - overtaken with 3f left - slipped back to third with 2f to run - unable to find more in 4th entering final furlong - eased back through the field to finish sixth
Slow to begin - settled towards the back and 10th at halfway - pushed along approaching 2f out - responded late but never a factor - finished 7th
Up with the pace - eased back to 5th at halfway - short of room 2½f out and faded - no more to give in the final furlong
Held up towards the back - still 8th at halfway - pushed along with two furlongs left but unable to close - held to the line

Slow to begin and left trailing - made up ground into midpack briefly before dropping back again - 9th at the halfway point - tried to build a challenge 2f out - lost momentum inside the last furlong - finished tenth well beaten
Slow to start - dropped to the back - 11th at halfway - roused 4f out without response - held 2f out and faded from there
Settled towards the back - asked for effort with 1f left and closed - kept going well in the closing stages - got up right at the line to win
Settled at back early - boxed in with 2f left - pushed along and made ground inside final furlong - found space between rivals in closing stages to snatch second by a short head
Settled in the pack early - improved into contention 2f out then pushed up into second inside final 2f - hit the front briefly a furlong out - caught close to the line to finish third
Sat close up early - hit front two out - pushed along soon after - overtaken inside final furlong and lost momentum close home
Settled just off the pace early - moved into contention over 2f out - pushed along 1f out - kept on to the line - finished fifth beaten under three lengths
Settled in the pack early - pushed along and dropped away over 1f out - unable to respond to finish sixth
Settled around mid-pack - pushed along with 2f left - couldn't respond and dropped away - finished seventh
Race in a forward position through the early stages - asked for effort with a furlong to run then drifted left and lost ground - finished eighth well held
Held early spot behind pace - dropped back 3f out - driven then dropped away steadily - finished well beaten in 9th
Went straight to the front - pressed for effort and lost command 2f out - dropped away quickly after - eventually beaten well home in 10th

Settled in midpack early - travelling keenly - 8th at halfway - slipped towards the back before 4 out - pushed on after 3 out some way adrift - responded with a swift return before 2 out - hit the front over the last and pulled away on the run-in

Travelled keenly close up - second at halfway - slightly awkward 4 out - moved clear by three lengths before 2 out - drifted left under pressure approaching last - overtaken on the run-in and unable to find more

Sets pace early but fumbled at the first and surrendered the advantage - eases back through the pack and towards the back before halfway - makes progress before three out - driven on into second before two out - clips the fence two out - fades approaching the last
Held up towards the back - error 7th - 11th at halfway - error 4 out - pressed for effort and lost touch before 2 out - error last then found some late finish on the run-in
Settled just behind the pace - 6th at halfway - improved into 3rd before 2 out - lost ground after that and had little left to offer late
Settled at the back early - improved position after 4 out - driven approaching 2 out - lost ground before the last and beaten well home
Held up early - still in twelfth at halfway - pushed but faded before two out and beaten off

Settled in the pack early on keen rein - stumbled 5th - 7th at halfway - improved into 3rd approaching 3 out - jumped awkwardly there - pushed on but faded fast before 2 out - scrappy again at 2 out - held no threat late finishing 8th
Sketchy jump 1st and dropped to the back - error 6th - well beaten from 3 out
Settled midpack early - dropped back to near last after a sluggish jump 2nd - error at 6th - well behind by halfway - driven when isolated from rivals after 4 out then pulled up before 2 out
Settled midpack out wide - up to 4th at the halfway point - dropped away fast into last before 4 out - eased out of contention ahead of 2 out
Settled in the back half of the field - 10th at halfway - dropped away and driven on before fading well behind then pulled up ahead of the final fence
Held up towards the back - error at 6th and again 3 out - stumbled and lost momentum when hampered before 2 out - pulled up before the last
Settled around midfield - up to third by halfway but blundered at the 6th - laboured badly and was withdrawn before 2 out
Hesitant start - went clear in front after first - held a two length margin at halfway - lost that spot and faded before 2 out then pulled up before the last
Up with the field on the outside - struck the front over 2f out - pushed along over 1f out and pulled right apart from rivals - kept on powerfully to win going off
Tracked front pack early - urged forward approaching 2f out then moved into runner-up spot inside final 2f - unable to close on winner - outpaced through the last furlong to finish second
Sat close to the front group early - asked for effort 2f out and made ground - stayed on same gear inside final furlong - finished 3rd
Handy spot wide early - asked for effort with 2f left - stayed on at unchanged gait to finish 4th
Settled in the pack - asked for effort 3f out - unable to find extra
Held up towards the back - driven from over 2f out - never got involved with the front markers - finished sixth
Held up towards the back - driven approaching final 2f - made no impression thereafter - finished seventh
Went straight to front - shown urging before losing command with over 2f left - fell back in a hurry inside the final 2f - eventually beaten a distance in 8th
Held up at the back - still only 6th at halfway - made ground on the outside 2f out to race 5th - improved into 3rd approaching the furlong marker - hit the front late and finished strongest

Settled in the pack early - 5th at halfway - moved up into 4th with 2f left - slipped back to 5th approaching the furlong marker - rallied strongly late to work into 2nd - held on for the runner-up spot without quite catching the winner

Slow into stride - settled at back before moving into contention early on - slipped to 4th by halfway - improved into 3rd approaching final 2f - 4th with a furlong left - rallied late to snatch 3rd near the line
Driven to the front from the off - soon overtaken - holding second at halfway - kicked back in front approaching 3f out - caught late and unable to find more finishing 4th
Settled towards the back early - into 3rd by halfway - cruising up to 2nd approaching the final 3f - fought for the lead inside the last but faded to finish 5th
Held up at the back - still 8th at halfway - pushed along into 6th approaching the final 2f - stayed on late without threatening to finish 6th
Held up at the back - still 7th at halfway - driven along 2f out with little response - dropped away inside final 2f to finish 7th
Settled with the field early - roused to hit the front - fought hard before giving way over 3f out - dropped away 2f out - finished well beaten
Sat close to the pace - pushed into second inside final two furlongs then hit the front with a furlong left - challenged again but held on to score
Set the pace early - pushed along a furlong out and lost the front in the final furlong - rallied back at the winner - narrowly touched off in a close finish
Settled at the back early - made headway approaching 2f out - pushed into third with a furlong left - kept responding to the line
Settled towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - found some late progress in the final furlong - kept going to finish fourth
Held up in mid-division - headway over 1f out - kept on but never a danger to finish 5th
Settled just behind the pace - pressed into contention 2f out - kept going late but never a factor - finished 6th
Settled at the back - nudged for effort 2f out and made little ground in the final furlong - no real threat to finish 7th
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along two out - lost ground final furlong to finish eighth
Settled in the pack early - nudged for effort with over 2f left - soon dropped away - finished ninth well beaten
Settled towards the back - pushed along with two furlongs left - unable to land a blow - well beaten at the line
Held a spot near the front early - dropped back 3f out - pressed for effort and faded - finished well beaten in 11th
Settled in the pack early - dropped away over 3f out - well held after finishing 12th

Held up towards the back early - hit the third and stumbled at the fourth then lost more ground - urged forward after three out - improved to fourth approaching two out - drifted left when asked for effort before the last - powered home late to score in the closing strides
Handy early - third at halfway - moved through with purpose to hit the front two out - pressed on before the last - overtaken close home and unable to find more
Went straight to the front - travelling keenly early - urged forward approaching 2 out then lost command there - driven before the last - lacked response and lost ground up the run-in
Held up in the pack early - improved into 4th by halfway then driven when losing touch approaching 2 out - stayed on at one gear to the last
Settled midfield early - holding fifth at halfway - urged into contention before 2 out - lost momentum and faltered approaching last - stumbled there and held on for fifth
Stumbled badly first and slipped to the back - still 7th at halfway - driven on after 3 out - lost touch before 2 out to finish well beaten in 6th
Sat close to front pair early - second at halfway - driven on after three out then dropped away fast before two out - finished well held in 7th
Towards the back - error at the 3rd - dropped to last after 3 out - driven before 2 out - hampered after 2 out and always out of the hunt
Settled midfield - 6th at halfway - driven on and squeezed for space approaching 2 out before falling there
Tracked close to the far rail in isolation - driven forward 2f out - edged left and hit the front inside the final furlong - stayed on strongly to win
Edged in front early - driven approaching 2f out then again inside final furlong - overtaken close home - kept battling to the line for second
Sat close to the front - urged forward inside final furlong - kept going without enough speed to get on terms - finished third
Held up towards the back - driven into contention approaching final furlong to move into fourth - stayed on same speed to finish 4th
checked early - settled midfield - driven for effort inside final furlong - kept going without gaining finished fifth
Slow to break - held up towards the back - urged forward with two furlongs left - moved left approaching the final furlong but had nothing left to give
Slow to break - held towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - always struggling to get involved - finished seventh
Settled just off the pace early - pushed along and losing momentum with over a furlong left - hampered in the process - held on for eighth
Held a midfield position early - urged forward with two furlongs left - dropped away quickly to finish ninth

Settled handy early on eagerness - moved smoothly to challenge inside final two furlongs - edged in front with a furlong and a half left - drew clear approaching the finish - kept finding more to the line
Held up at back - boxed in and shifted left with a furlong and a half left - found room to move inside the final furlong - powered home late to snatch second on the line
Went to front early - challenged and passed 1½f out - stayed on for 3rd but never looked like getting back up
Sat just behind pace - up to 3rd inside final two furlongs then 2nd with a furlong left - unable to threaten winner late on - eased back to finish 4th
Held up at the back - made progress over 2f out before fading again inside the last two - eased left approaching the final furlong - finished with late running to be fifth
Settled in the pack - pushed along with two furlongs left and unable to find extra gear - stayed on at one speed to finish sixth
Held up towards the back of the pack - pushed along with a furlong and a half left - unable to threaten and finished with little extra to give
Settled with the pack early - dropped away and pushed along a furlong and a half out - rallied briefly inside the final furlong but faded to finish eighth
Held up towards the back - nudged for effort inside the final 2f - unable to land a blow and finished ninth
Handy early - began to struggle 2f out and dropped back inside final two furlongs - unable to find more and faded to finish tenth
Held up towards the back - bumped a little over a furlong and a half out then squeezed for space - unable to find more inside the final furlong
Handy in the pack early - hit the front two furlongs out - pushed along and drove clear to the finish
Settled just behind the pace - pressed for a run inside the final furlong - closed steadily through the last strides to snatch second - beaten 3 lengths in defeat
Settled just behind the pace - urged forward with two furlongs left - made ground in the closing stages - edged into second near the line but overhauled again to finish third
Handy in the pack early - moved into second 2f out under pressure - stayed on through final furlong - edged out of second close to the line
Went straight to the front - pressed for effort and lost the advantage 2f out - dropped away in the final furlong - finished 5th
Settled in the pack - pushed along over 2f out and found some late headway - lost momentum inside final furlong to finish sixth
Settled in the pack early - nudged for effort with over two furlongs left - dropped away soon after - finished well beaten in 7th
Handy early - driven and dropped away 4f out - allowed to drift out of contention 2f out - well beaten in 8th

Settled behind pace early - moving smoothly - stumbled at 5th - up into second by halfway - driven approaching 3 out - improved into second 2 out - locked together with rival at the last - edged in front close home to prevail

Settled in a forward spot - third at halfway - blundered three from home - moved through to hit the front approaching two out - matched stride at the last - drifted left on the run-in and nabbed close home

Set the pace from the off - held a two-length margin at halfway - urged for effort and lost command before two out - clumsy at that fence - dropped away rapidly approaching the last and made no dent on the run-in - finished third
Settled midpack under keen restraint - improved into contention before the 5th - lost touch and dropped away approaching 2 out - finished well held in 4th
Held a forward spot early - travelled wide of rivals and up in 4th at halfway - urged on but faded fast before two out - well held at the finish
Settled around midfield - suffered a heavy knock after the 4th and blundered at the next - lost touch approaching three out - well behind at the finish
Settled at the back pulling hard - untidy over the obstacles and knocked about after the 4th - lost touch with the field once pressed before three out - trailed home well beaten
Settled at the back - pulled hard in the early stages - severely hampered after the 4th and blundered the next - dropped away well before 3 out and finished a remote 8th
Held up towards the back - stumbled at the 1st - knocked sideways after the 4th - lost touch before three out and finished well adrift
Settled around midfield - came down at the 4th
Held up towards the back - still 6th at halfway - jumped awkwardly and drifted right before running out after 3 out
Handy on the outside in second - asked for effort 3f out without gaining ground - driven approaching final furlong and made up ground - hit the front inside the last 110 yards and won comfortably
Went straight to front - driven out past 2f out and edged clear - advantage cut inside final furlong - overtaken close home and unable to fight back
Held up in the pack early - roused into third spot with over 2f to run - stayed on but unable to reach the leading pair - finished third
Tracked leaders on rail - urged forward approaching halfway - lost touch with the pack over 2f out - held on for fourth
Missed the break - scrubbed up at the rear - detached from the field 3f out

Slow to break - settled towards the back - moving smoothly to make ground into the last two furlongs - pressed the front-runner approaching the final furlong - swept ahead soon after - pulled clear in the run-in - won going away

Slow to break - settled handy in the pack - improved into contention 2 1/2f out - hit the front approaching 2f out - challenged hard inside the final furlong - swiftly overtaken - stayed on to the line without troubling the winner - finished second
Held up at the back - moved through 2f out to be third with a furlong left - shifted right inside the final furlong - finished 3rd holding effort to the line
Held up at the back - pushed along with 2f left - found some headway inside the final furlong to move up to 4th - stayed on late but never landed a serious blow
Settled midfield - dropped back and pushed along inside final two furlongs - rallied approaching the last furlong to finish fifth without gaining further ground

Went straight to front - quickly overtaken and sat second - nosed back in charge approaching 2f out before giving it up soon after - dropped away and driven along a furlong out - faded through final stages
Sat close to front early - pushed to keep up over 2f out then dropped back - faded final furlong to finish 7th
Handy early then eased across to hit the front - pushed along and overtaken approaching 2f out - slipped back and faded fast inside final furlong to finish eighth
Settled towards the back of the pack - crept into the pack by halfway before fading with two and a half furlongs left - dropped away in the closing stages to finish ninth
Set the pace from the off - bumped one furlong in - pushed along with a furlong to run and kept up the fight to the line
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along with two furlongs left - moved into second a furlong out - drifted right inside the final furlong but couldn't land a blow on the winner
Settled midpack early - eased right and made progress inside final furlong - stayed on to snatch third on the line
Sluggish start - settled towards the back - made progress into contention with a furlong left - boxed in for room briefly - stayed on but denied third close home
Settled at the back - pushed along with mild progress inside final furlong - unable to close - finished fifth

Drifted left and took a strong hold early - bumped alongside another runner after the first furlong while up with the pace - found little room and couldn't find more inside the final furlong - eventually well held in 6th
Settled in rear but pulled hard early - dropped away over 2f out and faded into 7th
Sat close to pace early - pushed to the front inside final furlong - drove clear to score
Went straight to the front - pressed for effort and lost command inside the last furlong - stayed on to the line but narrowly denied
Sat third early - pushed along inside final furlong - stayed on at one level to finish third beaten 2¼ lengths
Held up towards the back - hampered on the turn 3f out - finished well down the middle from inside the final furlong - nabbed the front right on the line to score
Settled in the pack early - driven to move through from 2f out - drifted left with a furlong left - hit the front inside the final 110yds but caught right on the line
Handy up front - driven approaching 2f out - squeezed for space with 1f left - stayed on but couldn't match the front two late
Held up in the pack - driven approaching final two furlongs then responded steadily inside the last - claimed fourth close home
Settled in second early - hit the front two furlongs out then came under pressure and lost that spot inside the final furlong - dropped away close home to finish fifth
Held up towards back - improved into contention 3f out and closed on front pack approaching final furlong - stayed on same gear to finish sixth
Settled in the pack early - improved into contention over 2f out - pushed along a furlong later - faded close to home to finish seventh
Sets the pace early - overtaken 2f out and lost touch with the front soon after - dropped away inside final furlong to finish eighth
Missed the break and lost ground at the start - veered right and collided with a neighbour crossing into the straight around 3f out - faded from over 1f out to finish 9th

Set the pace from the off - clear by two lengths at halfway - eased further ahead before the second-last surging along easily - drifted left at that fence - stayed on determinedly to win with plenty in hand

Held up towards the back - still 8th at halfway - improved into contention 3 out - driven approaching 2 out and again before the last - stayed on but unable to overhaul winner up the straight - finished 2nd beaten under 5 lengths
Tracked the front pair - stumbled at the 2nd - fourth by halfway - urged forward approaching 2 out and jumped awkwardly there - driven before the last - stayed on same gear to finish third
Handy early - second at halfway - dropped away before 2 out - held no threat late finishing 4th
Hampered at the start - dropped to the back - nudged up approaching 3 out with progress on the outside - blundered at the last - finished fifth having got no closer
Settled in the pack early - clipped a hurdle around 8th - up to 7th by halfway - driven up approaching two out - errs at the last then fades on the run-in to finish 6th

Settled towards the back of the pack early - scrappy jumping through midfield - 9th at halfway - bumped after the 11th and blundered next - untidy again 3 out - driven but faded from there - well beaten at the finish
Held up towards the back - poor leap at the opening fence - lost touch with the field soon after - well behind from before the 11th and finished a distant last
Raced up with leaders early - still 3rd at halfway - blundered 3 out and needed urging - lurched left 2 out - well beaten before the last
Squeezed for space early - settled in the pack - 5th at halfway - clipped a fence 5 out - driven approaching 2 out where a blunder led to being unshipped
Settled midfield early - 6th at halfway - blundered severely and unseated at the 11th
Settled in the pack early - drifted left over the opening fence - lost touch with the field and was withdrawn before the 9th
Bumped at the start - settled towards the back - dislodged rider at the 3rd
Set the pace from the off - kicked on approaching the final furlong and a half - opened up a big advantage though drifted about inside the last - held on without pressure to score

settled in the pack - driven and made good progress inside the final furlong - into second under pressure - kept going to the line but unable to reach winner finishing 2nd beaten two and a half lengths
Handy early - driven approaching 2f out - outpaced by winner inside final furlong but continued to the line without faltering
Settled in the pack - urged forward with over 2f left - kept going without threatening
Sat close to the leading duo early - urged forward but slipped back 2f out - weakened into fifth
Slow to stride - chased from the back of the pack - outpaced in the closing stages and no threat throughout
Settled in the pack - roused approaching final furlong - unable to close and finished seventh
Missed the break - held up in the middle of the field - ridden over 1f out but always struggling to get involved
Held up towards the back - driven for effort but lost ground with two furlongs left - finished ninth beaten well over 12 lengths
Held up towards the back - driven with over two furlongs left - unable to respond - finished tenth
Held up towards the back - dropped away 2f out - well held at the finish
Went in front early by a whisker - cruising with two furlongs to run - pulled clear approaching the final furlong and a half - kept finding more to the line for an easy win

Held up towards the back of the pack early - began to make ground inside the final two furlongs - up to 4th with a furlong left then finished strongly late to snatch second - never able to challenge the winner
Sat just behind the front-runner - unable to threaten up front a furlong out - held effort to the line but slipped to third late

Slow to break - soon within touch of the front group - third with a furlong and a half left - unable to threaten the pacesetter approaching the final furlong - held steady effort to the line but slipped to fourth right at the finish
